ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-to-moderate; predominantly dark-gray to black pixels (approx. 90%) with very limited high-intensity white/light-gray pixel clusters along the periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark vertical band bisecting the fluke; multiple distinct dark-intensity circular blobs (mottling) clustered in the medial zone of the left lobe and scattered on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; interior angle is approximately 70-80 degrees with a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, irregular serrations along the perimeter; notable large indentation on the proximal trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a gradual convex curve toward the tips; trailing edges show a concave sweep from the tips toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark-pixel clusters (4 on the left lobe, 2 on the right lobe) suggesting localized surface scarring or barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation or divot on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined dark vertical pigmentation streak at the peduncle junction extending towards the fluke center.
